title: M. Ravindran v. Directorate of Revenue Intelligence

content.caseIdentity: M. Ravindran v. Directorate of Revenue Intelligence, (2021) 2 SCC 485
content.holding: Reaffirmed that default bail under Section 167(2) (now s. 187(3) BNSS) is an indefeasible fundamental right under Article 21; once the statutory period lapses and the accused applies, the right cannot be defeated by a subsequent chargesheet.
content.relevance: Leading Constitution Bench authority governing default bail motions under Section 187(3) BNSS.
